ADDITIONAL BENEFITS OF CONTINUED PARTNERSHIP

As a full-service non-profit organization providing comprehensive
programming to support its mission to enhance the quality of life for
animals and people through compassion, respect, and education it is
                                                                 -




CAS’s position that the city and county benefit from continued partnership
in ways which far-exceed the mere delivery of sheltering services. These
include, but are not limited to:

   • The benefit of career animal welfare professionals in determining
     sheltering operations, policy, and service delivery.
   • Significant cost-savings for things like material supplies due to
     nonprofit discount programs and in-kind contributions.
   • Further savings through the support of donors and the lack of
     fundraising expenses incurred to support those donors as part of the
     service valuation.
   • Reputational enhancement through association with humane
     education and outreach programming, increased access to veterinary
     care for underserved populations, and human health and safety
     prevention programming.
   • Support and guidance for policy decisions related to animal welfare
     and the continued cultivation of a humane community.
